title: A Frail Woman Orders Tea
text:
Yun Shizhen entered Sera's tea shop coughing softly.

She looked like a strong breeze might carry her into the next province.

Pale skin. Thin wrists. Dark hair pinned simply. A small medicine pouch at her waist.

Sera assumed she was ill.

That lasted until Rhen came downstairs.

He stopped.

Looked at Yun.

Looked at the cup.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Sera.”

[[speaker:sera]]“What?”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Do not touch her.”

Yun looked offended.

[[speaker:yun]]“Rude.”

Rhen pointed at the table.

[[speaker:rhen]]“The wood is poisoned.”

Sera slowly moved her hand away.

[[speaker:yun]]“Only slightly.”

This was the candidate for #10.

**Yun Shizhen — the Pale Venom.**

Her **Ten Thousand Venoms Scripture** had been built through decades of controlled toxin exposure until conventional poison became nearly meaningless to her.

Her body was genuinely frail by Top Ten standards.

Her blood, breath, skin oils, needles, powders and qi were not.

[[speaker:sera]]“You poisoned my table.”

[[speaker:yun]]“Accidentally.”

Rhen:

[[speaker:rhen]]“No.”

Yun smiled.

[[speaker:yun]]“Fine. Partly accidentally.”

title: The Pale Venom
text:
Yun's first ranking opponent laughed at her.

He stopped thirty seconds later.

His left arm would not move.

[[speaker:opponent]]“What did you do?”

Yun tilted her head.

[[speaker:yun]]“You breathed.”

Her fighting style was not glamorous.

That made it worse.

One needle missed and struck the wall. Another hit the floor. A third grazed cloth.

The opponent assumed poor accuracy.

Then his circulation accelerated.

So did the poison.

**Seven-Colored Meridian Rot** used different toxin families against muscle control, perception, blood pressure, fatigue, pain response and qi circulation. The seventh became more aggressive the harder the victim circulated internal energy.

The opponent tried a grand technique.

His knees failed.

Yun caught him before his head struck stone.

[[speaker:yun]]“Careful.”

She looked genuinely concerned.

Sera watched from the gallery.

[[speaker:sera]]“She's terrifying.”

Rhen nodded.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Yes.”

Yun waved cheerfully at them.

Sera did not wave back.

title: Garden Where Nothing Lives
text:
The ranking council demanded a battlefield test.

Yun requested open ground.

Everyone assumed that disadvantaged her.

They were wrong.

Her opponent was a body cultivator famous for poison resistance.

[[speaker:opponent]]“I have trained against venom for twenty years.”

Yun looked impressed.

[[speaker:yun]]“That's wonderful.”

Then she activated:

**Grand Art — Garden Where Nothing Lives.**

No giant green fog. No theatrical cloud.

Fine droplets. Powders carried by disturbed air. Needles placed in the ground. Qi-carried toxins too subtle to see.

The entire field became hostile.

The body cultivator lasted four minutes.

Not because his resistance disappeared, but because every defense required circulation and every circulation changed which toxin became dominant.

Yun walked through the contaminated ground normally.

By the fifth minute, the examiner ended the trial.

Yun bowed.

Then coughed.

The audience laughed nervously.

No one underestimated the cough anymore.

title: Sera Spars With Poison
text:
Sera challenged Yun herself.

Not formally.

Curiosity.

Rhen disliked the idea intensely.

[[speaker:rhen]]“No.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Marriage did not give you veto power.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“I remember.”

Yun smiled.

[[speaker:yun]]“I like her.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“I know.”

The spar began carefully.

Sera's advantage was obvious: speed, physicality, assassin geometry. If she reached Yun cleanly, the fight ended.

Yun's advantage was equally obvious: everything between them might already be poisoned.

Sera used Veiled Moon.

Yun scattered three powders.

Sera changed route.

One needle cut her sleeve, not skin.

Still dangerous.

Sera reached the inside line and stopped a finger from Yun's throat.

[[speaker:sera]]“Mine.”

Yun smiled.

[[speaker:yun]]“Also mine.”

A transparent residue covered the cuff Sera had used to block.

They had both landed.

The judges called Sera the winner.

Rhen called the entire exercise stupid.

Sera kissed his cheek.

[[speaker:sera]]“Feel better?”

[[speaker:rhen]]“No.”

title: Seventeen Layers
text:
Sera collapsed two hours later.

Yun had not expected the poison to remain dangerous that long.

It had interacted with residual damage from the Black Sun basin — an old meridian scar neither of them had considered.

Sera dropped one cup.

Rhen caught her before she hit the floor.

His expression changed completely.

Yun was beside him instantly.

[[speaker:yun]]“Wait. I know this.”

She opened three antidote cases.

Rhen touched Sera's wrist.

Frozen qi gathered.

**TRANSCENDED SKILL — SPRING AFTER SNOW.**

Warmth followed winter.

Poison pathways separated.

One layer.

Another.

Another.

Yun stared.

[[speaker:yun]]“That should not be possible.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Why?”

[[speaker:yun]]“I made that poison.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“I know.”

[[speaker:yun]]“It has seventeen layers.”

Rhen's fingers shifted.

[[speaker:rhen]]“Sixteen now.”

Yun's mouth opened.

Sera, half-conscious:

[[speaker:sera]]“Please do not become friends.”

Rhen smiled.

Yun looked offended.

[[speaker:yun]]“I was going to ask questions.”

[[speaker:sera]]“Exactly.”

title: Poison Returning to the Source
text:
Yun's final ranking test involved another poison master.

That was a mistake.

He opened with paralytic mist.

Yun walked through it.

Nothing.

Blood toxin.

Nothing.

Then he managed to cut her hand with a poisoned blade.

The audience leaned forward.

Yun looked down.

[[speaker:yun]]“Oh.”

The opponent smiled.

Bad decision.

Yun refined the foreign toxin through her own circulation, mixed it with a compatible internal venom, then touched two fingers to his wrist.

**Poison Returning to the Source.**

His own compound came back altered.

He collapsed before his next breath.

Yun immediately administered antidote.

[[speaker:yun]]“That one was mean.”

Sera watched beside Rhen.

[[speaker:sera]]“She says that like she didn't invent it.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Concerning.”

Yun looked over.

[[speaker:yun]]“I can hear you.”

Sera smiled.

[[speaker:sera]]“Good.”

title: World Rank Ten
text:
The ranking tablet changed at noon.

**#10 — Yun Shizhen, the Pale Venom.**

She stood beneath it looking as though she needed bed rest.

No one laughed.

The rebuilt Marquis order now read:

#6 Sera — Pale Orchid.

#7 Mo Qingzhao — Paper Emperor.

#8 Arin Vale — Silver Sword Saint.

#9 Luo Wen — Laughing Undertaker.

#10 Yun Shizhen — Pale Venom.

Qin stood outside the active ranking.

Former #6. Semi-retired.

Han's tablet remained in the memorial hall.

Former #8. Deceased.

Yun looked at Sera.

[[speaker:yun]]“Do I get tea privileges?”

[[speaker:sera]]“No.”

[[speaker:yun]]“Why?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Table.”

Mo appeared carrying three notebooks.

[[speaker:mo]]“I have questions about toxin-paper interactions.”

Sera closed her eyes.

[[speaker:sera]]“You two are not allowed to collaborate inside my shop.”

title: Three New Graves
text:
The Nine Graves Society waited until the new Top Ten was official.

Then three burial markers appeared outside the ranking hall.

VI.

VII.

X.

Sera.

Mo.

Yun.

Not the old structure.

The new one.

Sera understood immediately.

They had wanted turnover because turnover created unfamiliar matchups, less institutional knowledge, and new coordination problems.

Mo crouched beside his marker.

[[speaker:mo]]“Poor paper quality.”

Sera stared.

[[speaker:sera]]“That is your concern?”

[[speaker:mo]]“One of several.”

Yun touched hers with a needle.

[[speaker:yun]]“Poisoned.”

Everyone stepped back.

She smiled.

[[speaker:yun]]“Not mine.”

Rhen stood beside Sera.

No marker for him.

Of course not.

Nine Graves was not suicidal.

Sera looked at the stones.

[[speaker:sera]]“Good.”

Mo glanced up.

[[speaker:mo]]“Good?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Now we know they are nervous.”

title: Haejin Returns
text:
Seo Haejin returned because Arin asked.

The **Red Snow Widow**, an old-war assassin and former Top Ten figure, had spent years trying to kill Rhen, once saved his life anyway, and later became one of the strangest allies Sera had ever acquired.

Haejin entered the tea shop.

Saw Yun.

Stopped.

[[speaker:haejin]]“Who is the sick child?”

Yun smiled.

[[speaker:yun]]“Poison.”

Haejin looked at Sera.

[[speaker:haejin]]“Of course.”

Mo looked up from a notebook.

[[speaker:haejin]]“And him?”

[[speaker:sera]]“Paper.”

Haejin stared longer.

[[speaker:haejin]]“I leave for a while and the Top Ten becomes stationery and poison.”

Rhen laughed.

Arin entered behind her.

Haejin's expression softened immediately.

She had come because Arin asked.

That mattered.

The Nine Graves Society had studied the new Top Ten.

Haejin had studied organizations like them for decades.

The next move belonged to Sera, but the old assassin would help her see it.

title: A Grave Marked VI
text:
The first direct threat against Sera arrived at night.

No assassin.

No army.

One grave marker outside the tea shop.

VI.

Rhen found it first.

He stood over the stone very still.

Sera came outside.

[[speaker:sera]]“Do not.”

Rhen looked at her.

[[speaker:sera]]“You are doing the face again.”

[[speaker:rhen]]“Which face?”

[[speaker:sera]]“The one where somebody's entire bloodline becomes optional.”

Rhen almost smiled.

Sera took his hand.

[[speaker:sera]]“They want that.”

He looked at the marker.

[[speaker:sera]]“They want me to become your trigger.”

Rhen's expression softened.

Sera leaned up and kissed him.

[[speaker:sera]]“So we disappoint them.”

He nodded.

The grave marker remained outside until morning.

Sera did not destroy it.

She turned it around.

On the back she wrote:

COME YOURSELF.
